text:
rachel: Kicking off a short thread to finalize NovaHealth POC scope. Need to agree success criteria, how we'll get sanitized sample data in, SQ requirements (they attached SQ-5022), and a temporary burst plan for load checks. Target window: 8 business days (ingest + ~7k eval prompts).

ben: Proposed pass/fail: 1) p95 < 300ms for 256-token prompts, 2) weighted relevance >= 84% across labelled buckets, 3) automated checks detect zero PII in outputs for the blind set. We'll deliver scoring harness and a small smoke test.

lee-cust: Those targets look reasonable. Data plan: we can share a masked slice in our S3. Security prefers no long-lived cross-account roles. Can you do presigned-upload flow?

network: We support two flows: (A) short-lived presigned PUT into a Redwood-managed temporary bucket (fastest), or (B) cross-account read-only role scoped to a single prefix (requires their admin to accept our role). Presigned avoids IAM changes and meets SQ timelines. Note: VPC peering or private egress constraints push this into Private deployment and add weeks.

rachel: SQ-5022 requests proof that data is redacted before transfer. Can engineering provide a small client-side redaction utility and a checklist for NovaHealth security?

ben: Sharing a compact conservative redactor for CSVs — POC-grade only:
```python
import re

def redact_text(s):
    s = re.sub(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\b", "[REDACTED_SSN]", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\\b\\d{9,19}\\b", "[REDACTED_NUM]", s)
    return s
```
Have them run this locally before upload and retain a blind holdout set. We'll include a 1-page checklist: run redactor, remove documents labelled 'sensitive', reserve 15% blind set, and verify with local smoke harness.

lee-cust: We'll run that and hold back 15% for blind testing. We'll tag rows with a "channel" field for stratified reporting (values: intake, triage, support, billing). OK?

network: Good. For scoring we'll use fuzzy token overlap (>=0.8) plus exact for structured outputs. We'll send the scoring harness (python) and a 10-sample smoke test so they can validate before upload.

rachel: Pricing question  they asked about burst capacity for a two-hour load window during the POC. For short trials we can offer a temporary reserved node and a spend cap. Sales: can we offer a simple commercial?

ben: Draft commercial: $400 setup + $100/day reserved node (discounted) for the POC duration + per-token overage after cap. We'll include automatic spend alerts and hard stop at cap. Unused reserved days can be refunded as credit. I'll draft SOW language.

sec-bot: Ticket SQ-5022-response created (TICKET-7012). Security assigned. ETA for first-pass: 48h.

lee-cust: Timeline check: we'll produce sanitized CSV by Wed COB, Redwood ingest Thu, smoke Thu PM, full eval Mon. Any blockers?

rachel: That timeline is fine if presigned flow is used. Action items recap:
- @lee-cust: run redactor, create 15% blind holdout, upload sanitized CSV to presigned link (we'll send link today)
- @ben: share redaction script, scoring harness, and smoke tests by EOD
- @network: send presigned flow details and optional IAM role ARN if they change their mind
- @rachel: draft POC SOW with spend cap and circulate to customer legal
Reconvene Fri 9am PT to confirm ingest status. :white_check_mark: 

ben: I'll also attach a tiny local validator (5 prompts + expected outputs) so they can sanity-check the scoring locally before upload.

lee-cust: Thanks all  will start prepping files and the SQ artefacts.

rachel: Thanks team. If security insists on no presigned uploads we can pivot to cross-account role but that will likely add 2-3 days.
